statement: ∀ k : ℤ, (ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (fun t : ℝ=>Complex.exp (Complex.I*(t*(k:ℝ)^3:ℝ)))) ∧ ∀ j t, iteratedDeriv j (fun t : ℝ=>Complex.exp (Complex.I*(t*(k:ℝ)^3:ℝ))) t=(Complex.I*(k:ℂ)^3)^j*Complex.exp (Complex.I*(t*(k:ℝ)^3:ℝ))
proof:
intro k
have hcast : ∀ t : ℝ, Complex.I*(t*(k:ℝ)^3:ℝ)=(Complex.I*(k:ℂ)^3)*(t:ℂ):=by intro t; push_cast; ring
simp_rw [hcast]
have hd : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ=>Complex.exp ((Complex.I*(k:ℂ)^3)*(r:ℂ)))
  (Complex.exp ((Complex.I*(k:ℂ)^3)*(t:ℂ))*(Complex.I*(k:ℂ)^3)) t:=by
  intro t
  simpa using ((Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hasDerivAt_id t)).const_mul (Complex.I*(k:ℂ)^3)).cexp
constructor
· have hc : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (fun t : ℝ=>(t:ℂ)):=Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff
  exact (contDiff_const.mul hc).cexp
· intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => intro t; simp
  | succ j hj =>
    intro t
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
    have he : iteratedDeriv j (fun t : ℝ=>Complex.exp ((Complex.I*(k:ℂ)^3)*(t:ℂ))) =
      (fun t : ℝ=>(Complex.I*(k:ℂ)^3)^j*Complex.exp ((Complex.I*(k:ℂ)^3)*(t:ℂ))) := funext hj
    rw [he,((hd t).const_mul _).deriv,pow_succ]
    ring
